description: MCP Secure deterministic policy ruleset v3. This file's SHA-256 is stored in every ScanRecord to guarantee reproducibility. v2 added astSeverityScores (AST taint severity -> 0-1 score). v3 adds modelBPolicy: the real Model B's per-function scores are combined with the AST taint hits before the policy engine sees them.
astSeverityScoresRationale: high -> 1.0 trips astHardFail (>=0.6) for an immediate FAIL: unsanitized tainted data reaching a shell/exec sink within 2 hops. medium -> 0.55 sits above the review threshold (0.40) but below both the hard-fail gate and the fail threshold, so indirect flows and dynamic/file/deserialize sinks route to the REVIEW tier for human confirmation rather than auto-rejection. low -> 0.25 is a sanitized flow: reported as evidence, never verdict-changing on its own.
modelBPolicyRationale: Model B scores one function at a time and cannot see whether tool input reaches the risky call, so on its own it never FAILs a server. A Model B class score keeps its full value (and can reach fail 0.75) only when the AST analyzer reports a medium/high taint flow of the matching category in the same function. Otherwise a fail-level score (>= 0.75) becomes 0.55 (REVIEW, like an AST medium) and a review-level score (0.40-0.75) becomes 0.25 (evidence only, like an AST low). Reason: on 46 real MCP servers, using the raw Model B maximum failed 41/46; requiring AST corroboration for FAIL removes these model-only failures.

AST_TAINT.description: Command injection via tainted sink reachability. A single confirmed hit causes an immediate FAIL regardless of other analyzers.

MODEL_A_TEXT.description: Simulated fine-tuned text model detecting tool-poisoning and prompt-manipulation attacks (PMA) in tool descriptions.

MODEL_B_CODE.description: Model B v8.2: fine-tuned code model (UniXcoder + LoRA) scoring every function for command injection, path traversal, SSRF, code injection, SQL injection and unsafe deserialization. Served by model_b_service/ (set MODEL_B_URL); simulated heuristic when unset. Can FAIL a server only when the AST analyzer corroborates the finding (modelBPolicy).
